text: Leah's son Oliver starts reception on September 3rd. She's more nervous than he is, apparently.
Arturo got the promotion! He's going to be regional manager from early March. Need to send him a proper congratulations message.
Elif is expecting her second, due sometime in the spring. She's had awful morning sickness this time round.

Lunch with Kwame. His daughter Aisha graduates from Leeds on July 14th, and the whole family is driving up the night before. He's incredibly proud of her. Her degree is in civil engineering and she already has a job lined up with a firm in Manchester, starting over the summer. Kwame says she wants to work on bridges eventually.
Don't forget to get a card for Hamza's retirement do. It's at the end of the month, the 28th I think.
Natasha's little girl Isla is being christened on May 18. Hannah and James are the godparents.
Picked up the dry cleaning and booked the car in for its MOT on 11/4.
Matteo has handed in his notice. His last day is sometime next week, and he hasn't decided what's next.
Chen's wife had the baby on Tuesday! A boy, Kaito, 7lb 2oz. I should drop round with a meal for them once they've settled in.
Samir mentioned his niece is sitting her driving test on June 3rd. Third attempt, so fingers crossed.
Santiago starts at the hospital on 6/2. He's been out of work since January, so this is huge for him.

Esther's brother Victor is leaving the army after twenty years. There's a big party planned for early April at their mum's place, and Esther is organising most of it. She says he has no idea what he wants to do next, but he's talked about retraining as a paramedic. Their mum is thrilled to have him home for good.
Remind me to text Aleksander on the morning of his first day. He's starting at the bank on October 27th and is really anxious about it.
Gemma and Ben are expecting! The baby is due in late February. They're keeping the sex a surprise.
Ximena loves gardening. She mentioned she'd been eyeing up a proper kneeling pad and a set of Japanese pruning shears, which would make a good leaving present.
Anil's retirement party has been cancelled. He's decided to stay on part time until the summer instead.
Ask Nikhil how his son's GCSE results went. They came out last Thursday and I completely forgot.
Eilidh is doing her PhD viva sometime in early December. She's terrified and hardly sleeping.
Note to self: I start the new job on November 10. Need to return the old laptop before then.
Tiago's dog Biscuit had puppies last week, six of them. His kids are naming them all after footballers.

Coffee with Lena. She's been made head of department, starting after Easter, and her husband Aidan just got a new job in Bristol, so they might be moving over the summer. Lots of change at once, but she seemed excited rather than stressed. I said I'd help her pack if it comes to it. Must check in with her mid-May once things settle.
Malik's mum is having her hip done on 4/22. He's taking the week off to look after her.
Isla passed her ballet exam with distinction! Gemma sent a photo of her holding the certificate.
Hannah is going back to work at the end of the month after maternity leave. She's dreading the nursery drop-offs.
Victor wants to retire by sixty. He loves sailing and spends every free weekend on the boat.
Need to buy a baby gift for Alina before Sunday. Something practical, maybe a sling.
James O'Brien (Jim to everyone in the office) is leaving on Friday after thirty years. There's a collection going round and I've already put in twenty pounds.
Kwame called. Aisha got the job! She starts in Manchester on August 4th.
Batch cook on Sunday, dentist Tuesday at 9, and renew my passport sometime next week.
Ben's twins start nursery on 9/8. He's been doing practice runs every morning.
Elif had a scan yesterday and everything looks fine. She's due May 30th. I should send her a little something.

Dinner at Samir and Natasha's. They told us they're expecting, due around early March, but they want to keep it quiet until the twelve-week scan next Thursday. Natasha's sister Leah is also pregnant, so the cousins will only be a few months apart. Samir has just been made senior partner as well, so it's been quite a year for them. Remember to bring something for the baby when we go over sometime next week.
Hamza's eldest got into Edinburgh to study medicine. She starts in September and he's beaming about it.
Gemma is nervous about her performance review on June 11th. Her new boss is apparently very hard to read.
Wish Arturo luck before his interview for the director role. It's on 3/19 at 10am.
Aidan had his last day at the council on Friday. Ask him how the send-off went.
Santiago Fischer, the new guy in accounts. Vegan, cycles in from Hackney, two kids at primary school.
Esther's due date is 7/21 and she's going on leave from the start of the month. Ask her and Chen whether they've picked names yet.
Malik is starting a teaching course in January. Long term, he wants to work in a primary school.
Lena's daughter graduates on June 6th. Lena asked if I could take photos on the day, so I'm bringing the good camera.
Mrs Popescu next door has finally retired. Forty-one years at the same school!
Nikhil's daughter has her 11-plus on September 14th. He's more stressed than she is. Remind me to ask how it went that weekend.
The baby shower for Alina has been called off because she's been put on bed rest until the birth. Need to give her a call this week.

Kaito is moving to Tokyo for work sometime over the summer. His wife is pregnant, so they want to go before the baby arrives. He's been learning Japanese properly for the first time since he was a kid, and his company is covering the relocation. His mum is upset they'll be so far away, but she's already planning to visit for the birth in early October.
Aleksander loves vintage watches. He hinted that he'd love a new leather strap for his old Seiko. Good shout for when he gets his promotion.
Thank-you cards for the leaving gifts. Write them tonight.

Ximena's first day as deputy head is November 3rd. Uncle Matteo is throwing her a little party the weekend before, and the whole family is coming down from Leicester. She's excited but admits she's nervous about the first staff meeting.
Ben told me his dad passed his driving test at 67! Massive news in their family.
Hannah's son starts secondary school next week and she's struggling with how grown up he suddenly seems.

Catch-up with Eilidh. Her brother Anil graduates from his nursing degree on June 20th, she starts her new job on 7/1, and then they're all flying to Lisbon at the end of July for their parents' ruby anniversary. Busy summer. I should text her the week before she starts.
James and Leah are christening their twins on April 26th. They asked if I'd do a reading.
Victor's wife is retiring from the NHS at the end of the year. He keeps joking that she'll reorganise his garage within a week.
Did the big shop and sorted out the spare room. Nothing else today.
Esther "Essie" Wang got the promotion to head of marketing. Send flowers to her office this week.
Tiago's daughter is finishing her final exams in mid-June and then going travelling for the rest of the summer. Tiago is a nervous wreck about the travelling part.
Don't forget: Oliver's graduation is on May 14. Book the train tickets for the 13th.
Alina is a midwife at St Mary's and swims every morning before her shift. Lovely to chat with her properly.
Samir's sister just had twins, a boy and a girl. Born on 10/12, both healthy. Samir is now Uncle Sam, apparently.
Chen asked me to keep an eye on her son during his first week at the new job. He's working at the café on Elm Street. I should pop in sometime next week.

Natasha rang in tears. She didn't get the promotion she'd been working towards, and her manager is leaving at the end of the month, which means yet another restructure. She's thinking about applying elsewhere sometime in early spring. Need to call her again on Friday and maybe take her out for lunch.
